map.CLSI 折点对照，输入MIC值自动判定敏感(S)/中介(I)/耐药(R): CLSI breakpoint reference: enter the MIC value to judge susceptible (S) / intermediate (I) / resistant (R) automatically
map.血/尿培养报出 MIC 后，按菌种与药物查对应折点判读 S/I/R。: Once blood/urine culture reports the MIC, look up the matching breakpoint by organism and drug to read S/I/R.
map.按 CLSI M100 折点表逐药对照，输出 S/I/R 判读。: Compare each drug against the CLSI M100 breakpoint table and output the S/I/R reading.
map.教学演示折点与 PK/PD 靶点（如 %fT>MIC）关系。: Classroom demo of the relation between breakpoints and PK/PD targets (e.g. %fT>MIC).
map.：测得 MIC 0.06 μg/mL，对照本页 CLSI M100 大肠杆菌左氧: : measured MIC 0.06 μg/mL against this page's CLSI M100 E. coli levofloxacin breakpoint (S<=0.5, R>=4) reads S; if the MIC is 8, then >=4 reads R and the regimen must change.
map.S 就一定有效吗？: Does S always mean it works?
map.不一定，还需看感染部位浓度、患者免疫与 PK/PD；折点是群体概率，非个体保证。: Not necessarily; you also need the concentration at the infection site, patient immunity and PK/PD; a breakpoint is a population probability, not an individual guarantee.
map.CLSI 和 EUCAST 一样吗？: Are CLSI and EUCAST the same?
map.有差异，同一 MIC 可能判读不同，报告应注明采用标准。: There are differences; the same MIC may be read differently, so reports should state which standard was used.
map.能直接选抗生素吗？: Can I pick an antibiotic directly?
map.不能，经验性/目标性用药由医师与临床药师综合决定，本工具仅做折点对照。: No; empirical or targeted therapy is decided by the physician together with the clinical pharmacist, and this tool only checks the breakpoint.
